Province of British Columbia, Ministry of Environment and Climate Change Strategy (2019). 2018 B.C. Methodological Guidance for Quantifying Greenhouse Gas Emissions for Public Sector Organizations, Local Governments and Community Emissions. Victoria, B.C., January 2019 (DRAFT). 64 pp.

EMISSION-FACTOR REFERENCE, NOT A TECHNOLOGY SOURCE: belongs in source-details_reference.csv (no id assigned; suggest bc-env_2019_001). Only _factors.csv written. Locators are printed page numbers (Tables 1-4 on pp.13-18). Written because the document holds content not in ECCC 2026 Annex 6: (a) per-GJ stationary-combustion factors with the energy conversion factors BC applies (GJ/m3 etc.; heating-value basis not stated, Statistics Canada RESD 2013), (b) B.C. electricity emission factors (BC Hydro, FortisBC, Nelson Hydro) 2010-2017 and three-year-average grid factors for AB, ON, QC, NS and some foreign countries. The fuel emission factors themselves are 2016-NIR values (1990-2014 NIR Annex 6, British Columbia marketable gas 1.926 kg/m3) and are superseded by eccc_2026_001. The BC electricity factors cover generation only and exclude imports. Not loaded: mobile fuels, business travel, refrigerants, paper, agriculture, district-energy tier thresholds (Table 5, p.20; tCO2e/GWh bands, building-sector use), energy-intensity-unit tables. Document is a January 2019 DRAFT.
